name: Firefly III Mobile
blurb: Firefly III Mobile is an unofficial Android client for Firefly III.
description:
Firefly III Mobile is an unofficial Android client for Firefly III. It is designed for users to add / view their financial data on the go.
It provides several features to interact with Firefly III backend.

• Manage your finances on the go: Access your Firefly III data even when it is unreachable from the outside world.

• Automation: Automate adding transactions

• Meaningful Reports: Financial reports give you overview of your spending and income within the app
